test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristics of the National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZs) of India?

options.text: The state government will provide power connectivity, water and other infrastructural facilities.
At least 30% of the total land area proposed for the NIMZ is to be utilized for manufacturing units.
A special purpose vehicle will be constituted to take care of the functioning of NIMZs
It prescribes a minimum area of 10000 hectares for establishing NIMZs.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It prescribes a minimum area of 10000 hectares for establishing NIMZs**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• NIMZs are developed to promote manufacturing and attract investment in the industrial sector, as part of the** National Manufacturing Policy, 2011.**
 
• Each NIMZ is a large industrial cluster, spread over a minimum of **5,000 hectares, with integrated infrastructure,** including **roads, water, and power supply.**
 
• NIMZs aim to increase the share of manufacturing in** India's GDP and generate large-scale employment** in the sector.
 
• Industries in NIMZs receive special incentives, such as** tax benefits, single-window** clearances, and easier compliance with labor laws.
 
• Some of the approved NIMZs are located in** Prakasam (Andhra Pradesh), Medak (Telangana), Aurangabad (Maharashtra), and Dholera (Gujarat).**
